bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 grep -Fq 'startPayload==="link"' /app/gaybbs.mjs
echo RUNNING_BOT_LINK_START_HANDLER=PASS
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 grep -Fq 'https://t.me/GayBBS_bot?start=link' /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs
echo RUNNING_PUBLISHER_LINK_URL=PASS
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 grep -Fq 'post:link:cancel:' /app/gaybbs.mjs
echo LINK_EDITOR_BUNDLED=PASS
